metadata.title: SlingSite: Free Image and Video Optimizer, Resizer and Converter
metadata.description: Compress, resize and convert images and videos, or extract a video thumbnail, for free in your browser. Your files never leave your device. JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, MP4 and WebM.

hero.title: Web-ready images and videos, right in your browser
hero.subtitle: Compress, resize and convert your media, or grab a video's thumbnail, in a few clicks. Free, with no sign-up, and your files never leave your device.

features.heading: One toolbox for all your media
features.subheading: Pick the tool that fits the job. Every tool handles as many files as you want at once.

optimize.title: Optimize for the web
optimize.description: Get every size and next-gen format your website needs from a single upload.
points: Images in JPG, WebP and AVIF
Videos in MP4 (H.264, H.265) and WebM, plus a poster image

resize.title: Resize
resize.description: Shrink images and videos by percentage, width or height. The aspect ratio is always kept.
points: Keeps each file in its own format, or converts it
Never upscales, so no blurry results

convert.title: Convert formats
convert.description: Turn any image or video into the format you need, at its original size.
points: Images to JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF
Videos to MP4 (H.264 or H.265) or WebM
Reads PNG, GIF, MOV, MKV and more

thumbnail.title: Video thumbnail
thumbnail.description: Extract the first frame of a video as an image, ready to use as a cover or poster.
points: Save it as JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF
Works with MP4, WebM, MOV and MKV

items.title: Add your files
items.description: Drop images or videos onto the page, or pick them from your device.

items.title: Choose your settings
items.description: Pick the sizes and formats you want. Sensible defaults are already set.

items.title: Download
items.description: Save each file or all of them at once, or send them to Google Drive.

privacy.heading: Your files stay on your device
privacy.description: SlingSite does all the work inside your browser, on your own computer or phone. Nothing is uploaded and no server ever sees your files, so it is safe for private and confidential media.
points: Nothing is uploaded to a server
Speed depends on your device, not your connection
Free, with no limit on the number of files
